messages:
mika: Heads up — planning a weekend migration to slim our console analytics schema and normalize route/quota fields. Goal is smaller row size and faster listing queries.
elena: high level plan?
mika: 1) introduce route_profiles table (immutable keys)
2) dual-write from ingest for 2w
3) backfill historical telemetry into route_profile_id
4) cut reads to route_profile after canary
pranav: will dual-write be opt-in per tenant? heavy multitenant risk.
mika: yes — we’ll gate by tenant feature flag and start with low-volume orgs
ash: important: dashboards rely on route_label JSON today. if we remove that we must provide read-adapter.
elena: also quota routing currently uses quota_bucket enum. we discussed collapsing {monthly,monthly_v2} into canonical "quota_window". need compatibility shim.
pranav: SQL sketch for backfill I tested locally:
pranav: ```sql
ALTER TABLE route_profiles ADD COLUMN canonical_key text;
INSERT INTO route_profiles (canonical_key, key) SELECT CONCAT(route_group,'/',route) , key FROM route_temp WHERE NOT EXISTS(...);
UPDATE telemetry t SET route_profile_id = rp.id FROM route_profiles rp WHERE t.route_key = rp.key;
``` 
mika: good start. keep updates in small batches and track p99 write lag.
infra-bot: Note: backfill job will spawn 400 workers by default. Use --concurrency=50 for weekend run.
ash: for dashboards, plan a read-adapter that maps old fields -> route_profile.* and falls back to route_label when missing.
elena: what about query plans? joining telemetry -> route_profiles could explode. suggest storing route_profile_id as compact UUID on telemetry to avoid frequent joins.
pranav: agreed. that's why backfill writes route_profile_id directly and we keep route_label until cutover.
mika: canary schedule: Sat 0400 UTC enable dual-write for 10 small tenants, monitor dashboard-load and console-list p95.
pranav: monitoring: add new metric console.route_profile_miss and console.legacy_read_ratio + dashboard panel.
ash: will add eval to console tests for equality of counts between legacy and new path.
elena: ops playbook if p99 latency regresses >15%: revert canary flag and pause backfill jobs.
mika: final cut: after 2w of stable dual-write, run vacuum and drop legacy route_label column in maintenance window.
deploy-bot: canary toggle scheduled: canary/analytics-route-profile -> 2026-03-22T04:00:00Z
mika: action items: @pranav write batched backfill job, @ash build read-adapter, @elena add dashboards/alerts, I'll coordinate tenant list and rollout doc.
pranav: will open PR with job + safe-rate limiter. ETA tomorrow EOD.
ash: will prototype adapter today and post link.
elena: I'll add alert playbook and create a canary dashboard.
mika: thanks — tagging this thread as the source-of-truth for migration steps. Keep replies short in this thread for traceability :thumbsup:
